svg.text: Same footprint and scale as the ground floor artboard. North at top.
holo-emitter - overhead plan. APPROVED 2026-08-21; DERIVED from fixtures/demo-study/plan.json. Drawn at 26 px per metre; use the scale bar. All room dimensions are clear internal metres.
o standpoint for one facing; the dashed leader runs to the wall
line that facing views. The printed number IS camera_wall_m.
N 3.60 = facing N, standpoint 3.60 m from the N wall line.
"open" = no facing wall; the number is to the drawn far ground line.
Doubled red arrows = an opening, with the travel directions
through it. You arrive facing the way you went (orientation law).
LAW (a) - every facing's standpoint is marked, with its measured distance to the wall line it views. camera_wall_m is READ OFF THIS DRAWING, never invented.

LAW (b) - outdoor walls exist ONLY where the manor's exterior wall stands. The heavy black outline is the single source of every outdoor wall; the privy garden wall is the one further BUILT structure and is drawn as one.

The two stairs are the only exits between floors. GREAT STAIR: up travels north, so you arrive on this floor facing N; down travels south. BACK STAIR: up travels east, down travels west. Orientation law, blueprint 3.

Chimney stacks are continuous: every fireplace here stands on the one below it (solar/great hall, master bedchamber/dining parlour, guest chamber/library, muniment room/study, long gallery/servants' hall).
